headline.title: OpenAI files for IPO, following Anthropic
headline.summary: OpenAI has confidentially filed a Form S-1 with the US Securities and Exchange Commission as a preliminary step towards an initial public offering (IPO), following a similar move by competitor Anthropic earlier this year. This marks a significant development in the ongoing competition between the two AI companies in the IPO space.

articles.title: NeuroBait: I fine-tuned a model to spark dopamine for ADHD brain
articles.summary: A researcher has developed a model called NeuroBait, specifically fine-tuned to stimulate dopamine release in individuals with ADHD. This innovative approach aims to enhance focus and motivation by leveraging neurobiological mechanisms associated with the condition.

articles.title: Five things you need to know about AI
articles.summary: At SXSW London, a talk titled "Five things you need to know about AI" highlighted key themes and trends in the AI landscape, drawing insights from the annual AI10 list. The presentation aimed to inform attendees about the most significant developments currently shaping the field of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Apple’s WWDC AI demos looked more real after $250M false ad settlement
articles.summary: Apple's 2026 WWDC keynote featured a series of AI demonstrations that emphasized practical applications, following a recent $250 million settlement over false advertising claims. The presentations showcased various use cases, including individuals interacting with technology while standing and using their phones.

articles.title: Confidential submission of draft S-1 to the SEC
articles.summary: OpenAI has submitted a draft S-1 registration statement to the SEC on a confidential basis. The company has not disclosed a timeline for any subsequent actions related to the filing.

articles.title: Why Apple’s slow-and-steady AI bet is starting to look pretty smart
articles.summary: Apple's gradual approach to AI development is beginning to yield positive results, potentially countering perceptions that the company is falling behind in the industry. The article explores how this strategy may enhance Apple's competitive position in the evolving AI landscape.

articles.title: Mercor’s Brendan Foody calls out Sequoia, accusing it of ‘dual-pricing’ valuation tricks
articles.summary: Brendan Foody of Mercor has accused Sequoia of employing 'dual-pricing' tactics by selling the same equity at two different valuations. This practice has raised concerns about transparency and fairness in investment pricing among top firms.

articles.title: Contract2Tool: Learning Preconditions and Effects for Reliable Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
articles.summary: The article introduces Contract2Tool, a framework designed to automate the generation of lightweight contracts that specify the preconditions and effects of tools used by large language model agents. This approach aims to enhance the reliability of tool-augmented agents by addressing the challenges of manually creating and maintaining these contracts as tools evolve.

articles.title: How Small Can You Go? LoRA Fine-Tuning 270M-8B Models for Merchant Information Extraction in Financial Transactions
articles.summary: A study on fine-tuning models for extracting merchant information from bank transactions reveals that a LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1-8B model achieves 96.95% F1 score, but its large size presents challenges in memory, latency, and cost. The research explores 24 model variants to identify more efficient alternatives for this task.

articles.title: Can the Environment Speak for Itself? $T^{2}$-GRPO: A Turn-Trajectory Group Relative Policy Optimization for Caregiver Agents
articles.summary: The article presents a new approach called $T^{2}$-GRPO, which aims to optimize large language models for caregiver agents in dementia care by balancing long-term task objectives with immediate environmental dynamics. The method addresses challenges in reward assignment and the limitations of external evaluators in interpreting patient responses.

articles.title: Baichuan-M4: A Clinical-Grade Medical Agent System for Continuous Care
articles.summary: Baichuan Intelligence has introduced Baichuan-M4, a clinical-grade medical large model aimed at providing continuous care rather than just single-turn medical question answering. The system is structured around three main components, including Baichuan-Harness, which ensures consistency in reinforcement-learning training and real-world deployment while managing action constraints and long-term patient memory.

articles.title: Graph2Idea:Retrieval-Augmented Scientific Idea Generation with Graph-Structured Contexts
articles.summary: The article introduces Graph2Idea, a novel approach for generating scientific research ideas by utilizing graph-structured contexts instead of traditional flat text. This method aims to enhance the relevance and quality of generated ideas by better capturing relationships among various research papers.
